sloka: असौ पुनर्व्याकरणं ग्रहीष्यन्सूर्योन्मुखः प्रष्टुमना कपीन्द्रः ।उद्यद्गिरेरस्तगिरिं जगाम ग्रन्थं महद्धारयनप्रमेयः ।। ७.३६.४६ ॥
transliteration: asau punarvyākaraṇaṁ grahīṣyansūryonmukhaḥ praṣṭumanā kapīndraḥ ।udyadgirerastagiriṁ jagāma granthaṁ mahaddhārayanaprameyaḥ ।। 7.36.46 ॥

translations.english: Moreover, this immeasurable king of monkeys (Hanuman), desiring to learn grammar and with a mind to question, went from the rising mountain to the setting mountain, facing the sun and bearing a great treatise.
